title: feat(kanban): card footer with open comment threads and attachments (#36423)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #36423

The card's second item, time in column, was dropped by the maintainer's ruling 7122246952 (「不需要这个功能」); this card's acceptance is the first item alone, the comment and attachment counts, under the seat routes recorded with the stage-1 readings (7121884710): the comment count is the open-thread count the record page's icon shows, the reader is shared in `plugin-detail`, and the read is one grouped read per counted object over the loaded cards, never one per card.

## What changes

- **Spec.** `KanbanConfigSchema` gains `cardFooter: { comments?: boolean, attachments?: boolean }`, optional, no default, an inline `strictObject` (an unknown member is refused by name, so a later foot item is one more member). Regenerated: `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, the strictness-ledger counts; the `kanban` liveness note cites the reader, the board and the pin test. New `src/ui/kanban-config-card-footer.test.ts`.
- **Reader (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `comments/recordCounts.ts`).** `useRecordCounts({ dataSource, objectName, recordIds, comments, attachments, reloadKey })`, with `compileCommentCountQuery`, `compileAttachmentCountQuery` and `readRecordCounts`. Both ride `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders` (`POST /data/:object/query`, the reader's permissions):
  - comments: `sys_comment` where `object_name` is the object, `record_id` is one of the cards, `parent_id` is empty and `is_resolved` is not `true` (the SQL driver's `$ne` is NULL-safe, so a deployment that stores no resolution counts every thread), grouped by `record_id`;
  - attachments: `sys_attachment` where `parent_object` is the object and `parent_id` is one of the cards, grouped by `parent_id`.
  A refused read draws no count. A cut answer (`hasMore`: the door cut the groups to `OS_DATA_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`) is never read as the whole set: `askRecordCounts` keeps the exact counts of the records it names and asks again, still one grouped read per round, over the records it did not name, until an answer is whole, names none of them, or `MAX_COUNT_ROUNDS` (20) is reached; a record still unnamed then has no count, never a zero.
  The counts are asked again on a write to the counted object announced on the data-invalidation bus (`sys_comment` / `sys_attachment`), and while a new set of cards is asked (a lane's next page, a card created) the cards in both sets keep their counts, so no foot blinks.
- **Attachments panel (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel`).** An upload and the uploader's own delete go through the storage route, not the data source, so no mutation event carried them; the panel now announces each as a `sys_attachment` write (`notifyDataChanged`). A delete through the data door is announced by the data source's own mutation event, as a comment posted through the data source is.
- **Record page (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `RecordDetailView`).** Resolving or reopening a thread (the resolution door, `PUT /api/v1/comments/:id/resolution`) and a member's delete of their own comment (the own-comment door, `DELETE /api/v1/comments/:id`) go through the authenticated fetch, not the data source; each stored write is now announced as a `sys_comment` write. A refused write is not.
- **Board (`@object-ui/plugin-kanban`).** `ObjectKanban` asks comments only on an object with `enable.feeds !== false` and attachments only on one with `enable.files === true`, once its definition settles, and re-asks on refresh, invalidation and a host reload. The counts reach the cards through the existing `KanbanCardDisplay` context; `SortableCard` draws a foot (`data-kanban-card-footer`) with each count above zero.
- **Relay.** `ListView` (`case 'kanban'`), `ObjectView#generateViewSchema` and the Console's `kanbanViewOptions` relay `cardFooter` only when declared.
- **视图设置.** Beside the two card toggles: 「显示评论数」 / 「显示附件数」, each offered only where the object has that count, both off by default. A toggle writes its member on or gone; turning the last one off writes no `cardFooter`.
- **i18n.** `list.optionsMenu.kanbanFooterComments`, `kanbanFooterAttachments`, `kanban.cardFooter.comments`, `kanban.cardFooter.attachments` in all 11 packs (zh-Hant generated); the two `{{count}}` labels join the count-neutral list (the number stands after a label and a colon).

## Decisions made here

- **Orphan replies are not counted.** On the record page a reply whose parent was deleted is a thread of its own. The server read counts top-level comments only (`parent_id` empty), so such a reply does not count on the card. Counting it would need the parent's existence per row, which a grouped read cannot see.
- **A replaced ask is not called off (review N4, accepted).** When a newer ask replaces one in flight (a write announced mid-read, several files uploaded one after another), the older answer is dropped, but `askRecordCounts` takes no cancel signal, so over a cut answer its remaining rounds still run. Only a deployment that cuts grouped reads sees the extra reads; the reader's header states it.
- **Unstamped comments are not counted.** The record page reads a record's comments by `thread_id`; the card counts by the stamped pair `object_name` + `record_id`, the indexed key the read gate narrows by. A comment written before the pair existed is not counted on the card until `os migrate comment-parent-pair --apply` has stamped it.
- **The footer toggles are offered by capability**, comments where `enable.feeds` is on (opt-out, as the record page), attachments where `enable.files` is on (opt-in), so an author is not offered a count the object cannot have.

## Verification

- New tests, all green:
  - `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.cardFooter-36423.test.tsx` (4): the counts per card from exactly one `sys_comment` and one `sys_attachment` read over the loaded ids (resolved threads, replies and another object's rows not counted); nothing read or drawn without the key or with both members off; a count the object lacks is never asked; a refused read draws no count while the other still draws. With the board's footer read turned off, 3 of the 4 go red (the "nothing read" case is a control).
  - `plugin-detail/src/comments/recordCounts-36423.test.tsx` (8): the compiled reads, the answer's reading, and the hook's asking (once per set, again on a new set or reload key, never for a count not asked, no records, or a source without the grouped door).
  - `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.kanbanCardFooter-36423.test.tsx` (3): relay, the toggles' writes, and the capability gating.
  - `spec/src/ui/kanban-config-card-footer.test.ts` (3), plus a case each in `app-shell/.../kanbanDraft-36370.test.ts` and `plugin-view/.../ObjectView.harness.test.tsx`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `plugin-kanban`, `i18n`, `plugin-detail/src/comments` and the list's kanban and view-settings tests: 2,785 green. `packages/spec`: 30,067 green; the one red (`scripts/def-key-collisions.test.ts`) fails to find `tsx` in a temp copy of this worktree's `node_modules` and does not touch this diff.
- `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins`, `check:declaration-map`: pass. `type-check` for `plugin-detail`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`: clean. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `overlap-check`: exit 0 (shares files with #37581, #37422, #37366; each merges cleanly).

### Contract review round 1 (7202278679): S1, S2, N1, N2

- **S1** (a cut answer drawn as a whole one): `askRecordCounts` reads `hasMore` off the answer and asks again over the unnamed records. Pins: `recordCounts-36423.test.tsx` (the second round asks only the records the first did not name; one read when whole; an answer naming none stops) and board case (e) (a page of one group: every card past the cut shows its count, two grouped reads).
- **S2** (no re-ask after a counted row is written): the reader subscribes to the bus for each counted object it asks; the Attachments panel announces its storage-route upload and own delete. Pins: the hook re-asks on a `sys_comment` write and not on another object's; board case (f) (a thread posted on another card draws its count); `RecordAttachmentsPanel.announce-36423.test.tsx` (3: upload announced, refused upload not, own delete announced).
- **N1**: both exceptions to "the record page's number" are now in the changeset and above. The `cardFooter` jsdoc follows with the next change to `view.zod.ts`, as the review allows; this round leaves `packages/spec` untouched.
- **N2**: the counts of cards in both sets stay drawn while a new set is asked; another object's counts never.
- With the cut loop and the bus subscription turned off, 4 of the new cases go red. `vitest` over `plugin-detail`, `plugin-kanban`, the Attachments panel tests and the list's footer test: 4,666 green. `type-check` for `plugin-detail`, `plugin-kanban` and the changed `app-shell` files: clean; `eslint`: 0 errors.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #37612

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `eslint` on the changed files passes (the full `pnpm lint` runs in CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (full local suite not run; CI carries it)

### Contract review round 2 (7203377375): S2 remainder, N3, N4

- **S2** (the comment doors): `handleResolveComment` and the own-comment branch of `handleDeleteComment` announce a `sys_comment` write once the door answers. Pins in `RecordDetailView.commentsResolved-36075.test.tsx` (4): a stored ✓ is announced, a refused ✓ is not, a member's door delete is announced, a refused door delete is not. With the two announcements removed, the two "announced" cases go red. The reader's header now lists which drawer writes reach the bus and how.
- **N3** (seat ruling: in this commit): the `cardFooter` jsdoc and `describe` in `view.zod.ts` and the `kanban` liveness note say one grouped read per counted object, and over a cut answer one more over the cards it did not name, up to 20; the jsdoc also names both exceptions to the record page's number (round 1's N1). Regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`; `check:generated`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:api-surface`, `check:variant-docs` pass. The changeset names `MAX_COUNT_ROUNDS` and the 20-read bound.
- **N4**: accepted and stated (see Decisions).
- `vitest` over every `RecordDetailView` test (873), `plugin-detail/src/comments`, the board's footer test and the Attachments panel tests: green. `packages/spec` `view.test.ts` and the footer spec test: 492 green. `type-check` on the changed `app-shell` files: clean; `eslint`: 0 errors.
